FLASHCARD · FIRST WORDS & FAMILIAR THINGS · AGES 4–6 MONTHS

Apple Flashcard for Babies

A shiny apple. Round, red and familiar from your kitchen — a first-words classic that pairs picture, colour and snack in one card.

← BottlePrevious cardBanana →Next card

What this first word does

Brings the kitchen into card time, an object already part of every day.

Say it where it lives

The fruit bowl is where it lives — say apple when you pass by.

What it builds

Picture plus smell plus taste gives one word several memory pathways.

Print it like this

Bright white cardstock keeps the apple round and appetising.

Baby tip

Hold the real apple beside the card so the two match up.

Teach it, step by step

Want the full walkthrough? Open the Apple lesson on the Learning Path.
